text:
lina: Hey team — I'm seeing a small, intermittent bump of 502s on /v1/generate over the last hour. Low volume but recurring every ~10–20 mins. Can someone point me to the heatmap/dash that shows per-region + client-ip? Also would love 2–3 sample trace ids (span-level) I can paste into the incident ticket.

chris: Check the 'ingress-error-heatmap' dashboard -> Filters: route=/v1/generate, status=502, rollup=5m. Link: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/ingress-error-heatmap (copy/paste). For client-ip split use the dropdown on the left. :eyes:

pat: Quick way to grab traces: run this in the tracer UI search bar -> `service:gateway AND http.status_code:502 AND route:"/v1/generate" | sort @timestamp desc | limit 10` then open any trace and copy trace_id. If you want a curl to reproduce a failure path: `curl -v -H "x-request-id: test-502-$(date +%s)" https://ingress.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"}'` (not guaranteed to reproduce).

matt: For metrics, look at: metrics.redwood/requests_by_status (group by status, then by region). Also check `gateway.upstream_time` distribution — 502s with upstream_time ~0 usually mean immediate proxy rejects. If upstream_time >100ms maybe backend timed out.

lina: thanks — any recommended traces to grab first? I'm not sure if this is a client-side pattern or an overload thing.

chris: grab the most recent three from the tracer query above. Also check the ingress logs for `error="context canceled"` around those timestamps (shows client disconnects).

pat: I pulled one earlier: trace_id=abc123def4567890 (sample). Another: trace_id=ff9a22b33c44d55e. I dropped them into the ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-4532.

oncall-bot: FYI — alert `ingress-502-rate-high` fired 3 times in the last 72h. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/ingress-502-triage.

matt: If you want to quiet the noise while we investigate, propose adding a short debounce on the alert (increase window to 10m) and route-to-owner = eng-platform for now. @eng-platform can we get an owner on this?

lina: tagging @eng-platform — can someone take ownership of chasing the upstream cause? I'll keep collecting traces and add more to the ticket. :thumbsup:

chris: quick note — if any traces show `502` + downstream `504` hints, include the backend pod image/tag in the trace span; that often points to a rollout causing increased 5xx.

pat: added a sample log excerpt to the ticket:
```
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z gateway[ingress] ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_error="connection reset by peer" route=/v1/generate client_ip=1.2.3.4
```

lina: perfect — thanks. I'll watch the dash and update INC-4532 with more trace ids as they appear. If we see a sustained rise I'll escalate to SRE.

matt: thanks — ping here when you have 3+ traces and I'll correlate with infra metrics (cpu/gpu queues).

lina: will do. closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
